current_state: Operating LNG ship-bunkering / fuelling activity at the Port of Antwerp-Bruges (bunker pontoon, truck-to-ship, bio-LNG). A 'Antwerp LNG Terminal' bunkering record exists on GEM.wiki (proposed permanent facility at Lillo/Antwerp, last updated 2021) but is NOT in the current production GEM export. This is LNG BUNKERING infrastructure, which is outside the tracker's scope (all scales except bunkering).
missing_threshold_elements: Out of scope as an import/export LNG terminal: it is a bunkering/ship-fuelling facility, not a regasification import terminal or liquefaction export terminal. No in-scope (non-bunkering) terminal proposal at Antwerp surfaced.
watch_for: A genuine IMPORT/EXPORT LNG terminal proposal at Antwerp or elsewhere in Belgium (regasification or liquefaction, not bunkering) with an identified sponsor + concrete step (MOU/FEED/permit/lease). A second Belgian regas site, or any FSRU chartered/deployed to a Belgian port, would be a real discovery lead.
notes: Monitor entry is a DOCUMENTED NON-DISCOVERY: logged so future Belgium sweeps do not re-chase Antwerp LNG activity as a missing terminal.
